entities.name: Jan Kułakowski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jan Jerzy Kułakowski was a Polish politician and Member of the European Parliament for the Greater Poland Voivodship (2004–2009) with the Freedom Union, part of the Alliance of Liberals and Democrats for Europe and sat on the European Parliament's Committee on Employment and Social Affairs.
